resources.string: Update test build. Updates come from this phone’s local test feed.

boxlore works with Android Auto. If you installed it from GitHub or another store, Android Auto hides it until you turn on one setting:
- Open your phone’s **Settings** and search for **Android Auto**
- Scroll to the bottom and tap **Version** about 10 times, then tap **OK**
- Tap the **⋮** menu and open **Developer settings**
- Turn on **Unknown sources**, then reconnect your car
Android Auto hides boxlore until you turn on one setting. Tap to see how.
